label: Sleepy mouse
spokenText: Mission: play it like a sleepy little mouse. Tiny and quiet.

label: Stomping dinosaur
spokenText: Mission: play it like a big stomping dinosaur. Stomp, stomp!

label: Tiptoeing cat
spokenText: Mission: play it like a cat on tiptoes. Sneaky and soft.

label: Robot
spokenText: Mission: play it like a robot. Beep, boop, every note just so.

label: Little bird
spokenText: Mission: play it like a little bird singing in a tree.

label: For the bear
spokenText: Mission: play it for the bear. He wants to hear your song.

label: For the fish
spokenText: Mission: play it for the fish. The fish will swim to the music.

label: Make the Goblin sleepy
spokenText: Mission: play it for the grumpy Goblin. Can your song make him fall asleep?

label: For your buddy
spokenText: Mission: play it just for me, {buddy}. I will listen with both ears.

label: For the moon
spokenText: Mission: play it for the moon, way up high in the sky.

label: Watch your hand
spokenText: Mission: watch your hand the whole time, like a detective.

label: Count the notes
spokenText: Mission: count the notes out loud as you play. One, two, three!

label: Eyes closed at the end
spokenText: Mission: play it, and close your eyes for the very last note.

label: Listen closely
spokenText: Mission: play it with super listening ears. Hear every note.

label: Be the teacher
spokenText: Mission: the grown-up plays first, and you are the teacher! Watch and check. Then you show how it's done.

label: Guessing game
spokenText: Mission: think of a secret animal and play like it. The grown-up has to guess!

label: Freeze like a statue
spokenText: Mission: play it, then freeze like a statue at the end. Don't move!

label: Teddy on the piano
spokenText: Mission: put a stuffed animal on the piano. Play it for your little friend.

label: Play like a king
spokenText: Mission: play it like a king in a big castle. Very fancy!

label: Rocket countdown
spokenText: Mission: rocket launch! Say three, two, one, blast off, then play it.
